title: 第008章 琴音定身镇恶徒，软萌师妹显锋芒
content_zh:
面对迎面而来的重拳，蔡文姬神色依旧从容，脚下步伐轻盈一侧，轻轻松松便躲开了这一记猛拳。

    她常年依靠技能与身法周旋，躲避攻击早已成为本能，赵虎这种依靠蛮力的打法，在她眼中破绽百出。

    一击落空，赵虎身形踉跄了一下，心中更是恼怒，挥手示意身后四名跟班一同上前。

    “一起上！拿下这个不知天高地厚的丫头！”

    四名弟子应声而动，四人呈合围之势，从四面八方朝着蔡文姬扑来，拳脚相加，招式杂乱却带着凶狠之意。

    一时间，小小的院门口拳脚交错，灵气波动此起彼伏。

    在外门弟子的认知里，蔡文姬只有疗伤的本事，没有任何战斗能力。

    五人联手，拿下她不过是转瞬之间的事情。

    可下一秒，令人大跌眼镜的一幕出现了。

    就在五人即将近身的刹那，蔡文姬心念一动，灵魂之力催动技能，【胡笳乐】全力释放。

    体内胡笳仙骨震颤共鸣，音波直接从肉身向外扩散而出。

    一道无形无质的音波以她为中心弹射而出，在空中来回穿梭，精准命中在场五人。

    嗡的一声轻响，没有惊天动地的异象，没有绚烂夺目的灵光，效果却立竿见影。

    刚刚还张牙舞爪、攻势凶猛的五名弟子，动作齐齐僵在半空。

    出拳的停在半空，踢腿的悬在原地，张嘴怒骂的话语卡在喉咙里，整个人如同被施展了定身术一般，一动不动。

    双目圆睁，神色惊恐，意识完全清醒，身体却彻底失去了控制。

    眩晕禁锢，瞬间生效。

    全场瞬间陷入死一般的寂静。

    原本喧闹的巷道鸦雀无声，所有围观弟子都瞪大了双眼，脸上写满了难以置信。

    前一秒还气势汹汹的五名外门恶霸，此刻集体原地罚站，造型五花八门，滑稽又可笑。

    谁也没有想到，传闻中只会疗伤的软萌小师妹，控场能力居然强悍到这种地步。

    一出手，直接团灭对方五人。

    躲在人群里的蔡文龙脸上的笑容彻底凝固，瞳孔骤缩，心底掀起了惊涛骇浪。

    这是什么诡异的法术？

    连炼气四层的赵虎都毫无反抗之力，被轻易定住？

    这个堂妹，到底还有多少不为人知的底牌？

    他此刻再也笑不出来，取而代之的是浓浓的忌惮与不安。

    院门口，蔡文姬缓步走到几人面前，挨个打量着动弹不得的五人，小脸上没有半分戏谑，只有认真与严肃。

    “我昨夜已经警告过你们，若是再敢作恶，绝不轻饶。”

    “可你们非但不知悔改，还主动上门寻衅，仗着修为欺压同门，今日若是纵容，日后你们只会变本加厉。”

    话音落下，她调动【思无邪】的净化之力，源源不断的音律本源自仙骨中析出，化作净化音流侵入五人身躯。
content_en:
Facing the oncoming heavy punch, Cai Wenji still looked calm, her steps were light and she easily dodged the punch.

    She has relied on skills and bodywork all year round, and dodging attacks has long been instinctive. Zhao Hu's fighting style that relies on brute force is full of flaws in her eyes.

    The blow missed, and Zhao Hu staggered, feeling even more angry. He waved his hand to the four followers behind him to come forward together.

    "Come together! Capture this ignorant girl!"

    The four disciples moved in response, forming an encirclement and rushing towards Cai Wenji from all directions, using fists and kicks, and their moves were messy but ferocious.

    For a moment, fists and feet were exchanged at the door of the small courtyard, and spiritual energy fluctuated one after another.

    In the perception of outer disciples, Cai Wenji only has the ability to heal wounds and has no fighting ability.

    The five of them joined forces to capture her in a matter of seconds.

    But the next second, a shocking scene appeared.

    At the moment when the five people were about to approach, Cai Wenji had a thought in her mind, activated the skill with the power of her soul, and released [Hu Jile] with all its strength.

    The Hujia Immortal Bones in the body vibrated and resonated, and the sound waves spread directly outward from the physical body.

    An invisible sound wave ejected with her as the center, shuttled back and forth in the air, and accurately hit the five people present.

    There was a soft buzzing sound, no earth-shattering vision, no dazzling aura, but the effect was immediate.

    The five disciples who had just bared their teeth and claws and attacked fiercely all froze in mid-air.

    The one who punched stopped in mid-air, the one who kicked hung in place, the words he opened his mouth to curse were stuck in his throat, and his whole body seemed motionless as if a body-holding spell had been cast.

    His eyes were wide open, his expression was frightened, his consciousness was fully awake, but his body was completely out of control.

    Stun and imprisonment, effective instantly.

    The whole place instantly fell into deathly silence.

    The originally noisy alley fell silent, and all the onlookers' disciples' eyes widened with disbelief written on their faces.

    The five outer-door bullies who were so aggressive a second ago were now standing in a group, with various shapes, funny and ridiculous.

    No one expected that the cute little junior sister who was rumored to only be able to heal injuries would have such powerful field control abilities.

    With one move, five of the opponent's people were directly destroyed.

    The smile on Cai Wenlong's face, who was hiding in the crowd, completely froze, his pupils shrank suddenly, and a turmoil arose in his heart.

    What kind of weird magic is this?

    Even Zhao Hu, who was at the fourth level of Qi Refining, had no resistance and was easily immobilized?

    How many unknown trump cards does this cousin have?

    He could no longer laugh at this moment, and was replaced by deep fear and uneasiness.

    At the entrance of the courtyard, Cai Wenji walked slowly to several people and looked at the five people who could not move one by one. There was no trace of joking on her face, only seriousness and seriousness.

    "I warned you last night that if you dare to do evil again, you will not be leniently punished."

    "But not only do you not repent, you also come to pick fights and bully your fellow disciples based on your cultivation. If you indulge me today, you will only get worse in the future."

    After the words fell, she mobilized the purifying power of [Siwuxie], and a steady stream of music originally came from the immortal bones, turning into a purifying sound stream and invading the bodies of the five people.
title_en: Chapter 008: Qin Yin settles down to suppress the villains, and the soft and cute junior sister shows her sharpness
